name: Flexible Asset Allocation (top 2)
description: Concentrated variant of Flexible Asset Allocation (Keller & van Putten, 2012). Ranks each asset on trailing return, realized volatility (low-vol favored), and average pairwise correlation (low-correlation favored), combines with weights (1.0, 0.5, 0.5), and holds only the top 2 assets. Absolute-momentum gate redirects negative-trend selections to the safe asset.
